trigger: Back on Peavine. Where do your people winter?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Back in Sparks. Grey ash on the casinos. Carly's Switchboard is down to four radios that still work.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: The cards work? Walt says the cards work. So: Galena goes warm. Who goes with it?

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: The plant can heat a few hundred people. Maybe more with a greenhouse. Not the whole city. Never the whole city.

choices.text: We winter at Galena. Bring who we can.
We stay in Sparks. Run heat lines later.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Okay. I'll pick the list. No— we'll pick it together. Out loud. With names.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Then we hold the block. Lolo, Gil, the Pruitts. We hold what we've got until we can do better.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: And me? I know how they hunt. I know what light does to them. I'd be useful. I'd also be... a reminder.

choices.text: Go back to the Annex. Help Tolliver.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: Thank you. I'll earn it. Every night, I'll earn it.

nodes.speaker: reyne
nodes.text: ...Fair. I'll take the cart's old battery. Tolliver will want company. Or he'll shoot me. Either way.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: January is coming. The sky is the color of an old bruise.
